name: Midori (Gunma, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Midori city emblem in green: a ring in two shades of green enclosing stylised leaves.
history: Municipal flag of Midori, a city in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 March 2006.

features.role: Midori city emblem — a ring in two shades of green enclosing stylised leaves
